standard_prerequisites: The coherator functor DQ_X attached to a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space: its existence as the right adjoint of the inclusion of the derived category of quasi-coherent sheaves, and its bounded cohomological dimension
The Milnor exact sequence expressing the cohomology in degree m of a derived limit through the limit of the cohomologies in degree m and the first derived limit of the cohomologies in degree m-1
The affine comparison identifying sheaf cohomology on an affine etale open with the sections of the cohomology module, for complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves
Nakayama's lemma and its consequence over a first order thickening: a finitely presented module whose pullback along the thickening is zero is itself zero
core_obligations: Existence of DQ_X because X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the right adjoint computation that DQ_X commutes with products and hence with derived limits, which yields the equality of the two displayed expressions for K
Bounded cohomological dimension of DQ_X reduces the claim to showing that R lim K_n has cohomology sheaves bounded above

On an affine etale open U the Milnor exact sequence, together with pseudo-coherence of the K_n (hence quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves) and the affine comparison, identifies the only remaining obstruction: it suffices that the top degrees a_n with H^{a_n}(K_n) nonzero are bounded above independently of n

Pseudo-coherence puts each K_n in bounded above degree; Nakayama over the thickening X_{n-1} -> X_n shows that the pullback of H^{a_n}(K_n) to X_{n-1} vanishes only if H^{a_n}(K_n) itself vanishes (checking on stalks), whence a_{n-1} = a_n for all n and the top degrees are constant
proof_roadmap: Convert the displayed formula for K into a boundedness question using that DQ_X is a right adjoint commuting with R lim and has bounded cohomological dimension
Reduce to a uniform bound on the top degrees by the Milnor sequence on affine etale opens combined with the affine comparison for pseudo-coherent objects
Lock the top degrees with Nakayama across the thickenings of the descent system
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that the derived limit object K of the pseudo-coherent descent situation lies in D^- with quasi-coherent cohomology, at source lines 2694-2702, label lemma-compute-what-it-should-be-derived, whose proof occupies source lines 2704-2750. None of the load bearing steps is a citation: the proof first converts the displayed formula for K into a boundedness question using that the coherator DQ_X is a right adjoint commuting with derived limits and has bounded cohomological dimension, then on affine etale opens combines the Milnor exact sequence for R lim with the affine comparison for complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves to reduce the question to a uniform bound on the top degrees a_n, and finally proves a_{n-1} = a_n for all n by pseudo-coherence and Nakayama over the thickenings of the system, the parenthetical stalk argument at source line 2747-2748. The counted statement records none of this machinery: neither of the two reductions nor the Nakayama locking of the top degrees appears in it.
